Archive a Department

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to archive a department that no longer exists, so it disappears from the lists and the organisation chart but its history is kept.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Departments

Click Departments.

3. Find the department

Type the name of the department and press Enter.

4. Card menu

Click the three dots on the department card.

5. Configuration

Click Configuration to open the department form.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Archive

Click Archive.

8. Confirm

Click Archive in the window to confirm.
